name: Can rotted window frames be repaired, or do they always need replacement?

mainEntity.name: Can rotted window frames be repaired, or do they always need replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor rot in a localized area might be repairable. This often involves removing the damaged wood, treating the area, and filling it with an epoxy wood filler or replacing a small section. However, extensive rot, especially in structural components of the frame or sills, usually necessitates full window replacement. Repairing severely rotted frames may not be cost-effective or provide a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor rot might be repairable with epoxy, but extensive or structural rot typically requires full window replacement.
